content:
Hi everyone, I'm new here and started contributing to mathlib.
These two small Finset infrastructure PRs came out of formalization work while studying Erdos problems 857, 20, and 367, and I'd really appreciate feedback on naming/placement/style:

  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36003
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36005

Thanks for reviewing, and happy to iterate quickly on any requested changes.
Welcome. Are you using LLMs to communicate with reviewers? Your comments would seem to suggest you are.
You might want to have a look at https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/index.html#use-of-ai

Interesting response to a genuine human. I think the better use of general conversation time is not questioning the shovel used to dig the hole. It is to look at the hole and tell me what is good about it and tell me what you might polish or correct. I hope this makes sense.
@Yan Yablonovskiy 🇺🇦 Hey Yan, would you like to chime in more deeply? Or just a "cry" reaction? Please go into more detail, my friend.

Cody, the issue here is that reviewers do not want to waste their time trying having a conversation with what might turn out to be the shovel itself. It is clear beyond reasonable doubt to me that some of your comments on your PR were not written by a human, and your unwillingness to disclose this puts you at odds with the policy Julian linked above.
